programmes.d: Pamela and Michael fall back in love after 20 years, but the issues that drove them apart have intensified.
Kim and Frank seem completely different. They say opposites attract, but in this case, it's fatal attraction.
The newlywed bliss of Matt and Elsie wears off when Elsie catches the eye of one of Matt's old friends.
Charlie and Christine seek a simpler life in Vermont, but after a terrible car crash, a dark secret surfaces.
Jerry and Rebecca fall in love and open a general store together, but their happiness has a short shelf life.
When Ellen suspects her husband Mike is gay, the two veer onto a collision course ending in tragedy.
Antoinette and Spencer's marriage sours when her career takes off, leading to bitter accusations and tragedy.
A woman fights for her life as her boyfriend stabs her in the chest and then embeds a knife into her skull.
Acting as a good Samaritan to a 14-year-old boy, Danielle is shocked when the boy pulls a gun on her and forces her to drive to a secret location.
When a New Jersey woman is murdered on her wedding day by her ex-boyfriend, the case stirs a heated debate about the nature of crimes of passion.
The mysterious killing of a businessman leads to a precedent-setting case that reveals just how easy it is for two people to arrange a murder while chatting on the Internet.
In the end, the case would change the way the death penalty worked in nine states. But long before it got to that point, it was about a big score.
Kosta Fotopoulos, a prominent member of the Greek-American community in Daytona, Florida, invents a club for killers and convinces his lover to join the club by brutally murdering a drifter.
The justice system tests the bounds of a "crime of passion" when Houston dentist Clara Harris is put on trial for killing her adulterous husband.

Sometimes, people kill or claim the blame for murder because they want to be famous. We delve into the psychological motivations of murder and infamy when a mild-mannered, grey-haired grandmother accuses her boyfriend of the murder.

When a man's fiancée is brutally stabbed to death, he finds solace in the arms of a sympathetic ex-lover. But when she is later arrested for attempting to murder her own husband, a shocking web of love, obsession, and deceit begins to unravel.
Faced with mounting debts and his upcoming honeymoon, a delusional bloodthirsty actor casts himself in a role that includes murder and dismemberment.
An anti-drug crusader's home is torched. But when a body is discovered in the freezer, the curious case of arson becomes a twisted tale of fratricide.
When a couple disappears from a Georgia beach town, detectives interrogate a pair of gun-toting cat burglars with dueling cover stories, some sordid souvenirs, and a telltale scrapbook.
When she's caught stealing, an aspiring 20-something lifestyle blogger tries to prevent herself from being fired and gets locked up for murder instead.
In Prohibition-era Chicago, a down-and-out barfly looks like the perfect target for a get-rich-quick insurance scheme. That is, until he refuses to keel over.
A Georgia attorney falls head over heels for a sexy paralegal with a passion for horse racing, and has no idea she's about to become his worst nightmare.
A Michigan man is found burned to death in his own garage, and as the bizarre evidence piles up, investigators discover the body in the garage isn't his.
In a picture-perfect East Coast town, an 80-year-old widow is viciously murdered in a gruesome ritual killing, and the evidence indicates the killer cut out her heart and drank her blood.
A rich Canadian expat in Dubai reports that her husband is missing. And detectives soon find his decomposing body in a box in the building's utility room.
As detectives investigate the case of an acid-wielding assailant, they uncover a body in a dumpster and a preposterous identity-swapping plan.
While her swinging husband is out of town, a successful New Hampshire woman is beaten to death with a sex paddle.
